people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.
translations.bsb: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
